title: Decoding a switching trace
statement: Let $n,w\in\mathbb{N}$, let $\phi$ be a DNF formula on $n$ coordinates with width at most $w$, and let $\rho$ be a restriction assigning each coordinate one of the states free, fixed to $1$, or fixed to $-1$. For every switching trace $\mathrm{tr}$ of $\phi$ based at $\rho$, decoding the code associated with $\mathrm{tr}$ at the target restriction of $\mathrm{tr}$ recovers $\rho$.
hypotheses_covered: $\phi$ is a DNF formula on $n$ coordinates
The width of $\phi$ is at most $w$
$\mathrm{tr}$ is a switching trace of $\phi$ based at $\rho$
